metadata.title: [zh-tw] Ink
metadata.description: Ink 繁體中文化與微調
metadata.author: Chico

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Ink is all about enabling pen use directly in your Markdown notes.
ast.target: Ink 讓你可以直接在 Markdown 筆記中使用數位筆。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: In any Markdown note, run the following command to begin writing where your Cursor is.
ast.target: 在任何 Markdown 筆記中執行以下命令，即可從游標所在位置開始手寫。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: These can be added too and can be resized right in your Markdown file. Use the purple lock icon to save framing, or the standard lock icon to save the drawing but revert the framing.
ast.target: 也可以加入繪圖區塊，並直接在 Markdown 檔案中調整大小。使用紫色鎖頭圖示可儲存取景範圍；一般鎖頭圖示則會儲存繪圖，但還原取景範圍。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If using Obsidian Sync, turn on "sync all other types" in the Obsidian Sync settings.
ast.target: 如果使用 Obsidian Sync，請在 Obsidian Sync 設定中啟用「同步所有其他類型」。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Tips for using Ink, compatibility with other processes, and migrating from older versions.
ast.target: Ink 使用技巧、與其他流程的相容性，以及舊版本遷移說明。

ast.name: addLinkRow
ast.target: 以短片示範 Ink 的功能。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Two fingers or right mouse button to reframe. Cmd + right mouse button to zoom, or Cmd + scroll wheel.
ast.target: 使用雙指或滑鼠右鍵調整取景範圍。按住 Cmd 搭配滑鼠右鍵或滾輪即可縮放。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Hold cmd/ctrl to switch to eraser temporarily.
ast.target: 按住 Cmd／Ctrl 可暫時切換為橡皮擦。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If using "Obsidian Sync", turn on "sync all other types" in the Obsidian Sync settings.
ast.target: 如果使用「Obsidian Sync」，請在 Obsidian Sync 設定中啟用「同步所有其他類型」。

ast.name: text
ast.target: 遷移舊版 Ink 檔案

ast.name: text
ast.source: This version of Ink uses a new SVG format. Migrate legacy .writing/.drawing files and older Ink SVG files still on the previous format to unlock newer features.
ast.target: 此版本的 Ink 使用新的 SVG 格式。將舊版 .writing／.drawing 檔案，以及仍使用先前格式的 Ink SVG 檔案遷移，即可使用新功能。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Bulk-convert v2 SVG files still on <tldraw> metadata (referenced by embeds) to ink-canvas in place. Drawing embed viewBox is refit to stroke bounds.
ast.target: 將嵌入區塊參照、仍使用 <tldraw> 中繼資料的 v2 SVG 檔案批次就地轉換為 ink-canvas。繪圖嵌入區塊的 viewBox 會重新調整以符合筆畫邊界。

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Developer: Migrate tldraw SVG to ink-canvas
ast.target: 開發者工具：將 tldraw SVG 遷移至 ink-canvas

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: For information on this plugin's development, visit the links below.
ast.target: 若想了解此外掛的開發資訊，請前往下方連結。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Shows a toolbar toggle while editing so you can draw with your finger on touch devices. When off, fingers scroll the note as usual.
ast.target: 編輯時在工具列顯示切換按鈕，讓你能在觸控裝置上用手指繪圖。關閉時，手指會照常捲動筆記。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Which side undo/redo and extend controls appear on while editing.
ast.target: 編輯時，復原／重做與延伸控制按鈕要顯示在哪一側。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Features under active testing. They may not work on all devices and might be removed or changed in the next release. Expand for details.
ast.target: 這些功能仍在測試中，可能無法在所有裝置上運作，也可能於下一版移除或變更。展開以查看詳情。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Connects to the Boox companion app for passing through smoother pen strokes on supported tablets.
ast.target: 連線至 Boox 配套應用程式，在支援的平板上傳遞更流暢的筆畫。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 啟用 Boox 配套應用程式

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While held, the pen barrel button (button 2) erases instead of panning. May conflict with right-click pan on some setups.
ast.target: 按住筆身按鈕（按鈕 2）時，暫時使用橡皮擦而非平移。部分設定下可能與右鍵平移衝突。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 側邊按鈕暫時切換橡皮擦

ast.name: textContent
ast.source: Automatically detect pen or mouse from pressure (auto), use pen pressure and faithful smoothing (pen), or simulated pressure with higher smoothing (mouse).
ast.target: 依筆壓自動判斷使用觸控筆或滑鼠（自動）；觸控筆模式使用實際筆壓，平滑處理較忠於原筆跡；滑鼠模式則模擬筆壓，並加強平滑處理。

ast.name: append
ast.target: 上次偵測到的輸入方式：

ast.name: append
ast.source: If detection is incorrect, choose Pen or Mouse manually.
ast.target: 若偵測結果不正確，請手動選擇「觸控筆」或「滑鼠」。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While editing a Markdown file, run the action 'insert new hand drawn section' to embed a drawing canvas.
ast.target: 編輯 Markdown 檔案時，執行「插入新的手繪區塊」動作即可嵌入繪圖畫布。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While editing a Markdown file, run the action 'new handwriting section' to embed a section for writing with a pen.
ast.target: 編輯 Markdown 檔案時，執行「新增手寫區塊」動作即可嵌入可用數位筆書寫的區塊。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Height in pixels of each ruled line. Only affects new writing embeds.
ast.target: 每一行橫線的高度，以像素為單位。僅影響新建立的手寫嵌入區塊。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Number of empty lines shown below your writing while editing. Writing reaches the last line before the embed extends in height.
ast.target: 編輯時在筆跡下方顯示的空白行數。書寫到最後一行時，嵌入區塊才會增加高度。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Always back up your files. Expand for details.
ast.target: 請務必備份檔案。展開以查看詳情。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 此外掛處於 Beta 階段

ast.name: text
ast.source: Beta means the plugin is still evolving. Changes to embed formats and file-handling features, even when thoroughly tested, may occasionally introduce issues that affect your vault. Always keep backups of your data.
ast.target: Beta 表示此外掛仍在持續開發。嵌入格式與檔案處理功能的變更，即使經過完整測試，仍可能偶爾出現影響儲存庫的問題。請務必備份資料。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When enabled, debug information is written to an ink-debug.md file in your vault root. This includes writing and drawing activity, so do not enable this unless you are actively troubleshooting a bug to provide logs for a bug report. Disable it again once you're done.
ast.target: 啟用後，除錯資訊會寫入儲存庫根目錄的 ink-debug.md 檔案，其中包含手寫與繪圖活動。請僅在排查問題、準備提供錯誤回報紀錄時啟用，完成後請再次停用。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: When you lock or save the embed, those strokes become visible again.
ast.target: 鎖定或儲存嵌入區塊後，這些筆畫會再次顯示。

ast.name: text
ast.source: Scanning vault for notes that embed this file…
ast.target: 正在掃描儲存庫中嵌入此檔案的筆記…

ast.name: text
ast.source: Strokes will be scaled (smaller only) and repositioned to fit the writing page. This cannot be undone.
ast.target: 筆畫會縮小並重新定位，以符合手寫頁面的大小，不會放大。此操作無法復原。

ast.name: text
ast.source: The drawing embed viewbox in affected notes will be recalculated to fit the ink. Stroke positions are unchanged.
ast.target: 受影響筆記中的繪圖嵌入區塊會重新計算取景範圍，以符合筆跡邊界。筆畫位置不會變動。

ast.name: text
ast.source: Legacy tldraw format: layout adjustment does not apply. Only metadata and embed type will change.
ast.target: 舊版 tldraw 格式不適用版面調整，只會變更中繼資料與嵌入類型。

ast.name: text
ast.source: This file is not embedded in any notes.
ast.target: 此檔案未嵌入任何筆記。

ast.name: text
ast.source: Use "Duplicate and convert copy" to convert a copy and update only this note's embed. Other notes keep the original file.
ast.target: 使用「建立副本並轉換」即可轉換副本，且只更新這則筆記的嵌入區塊。其他筆記會保留原始檔案。

ast.name: text
ast.target: 移除嵌入區塊並刪除檔案

ast.name: Notice
ast.target: 已將嵌入區塊複製到剪貼簿

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Failed to copy embed to clipboard
ast.target: 無法將嵌入區塊複製到剪貼簿

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Could not read embed Markdown to copy
ast.target: 無法讀取嵌入區塊的 Markdown 以進行複製

ast.name: message
ast.source: This will remove all strokes from the canvas.
ast.target: 這將移除畫布上的所有筆畫。

ast.name: Notice
ast.target: 已連線至 Boox 配套應用程式

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 正在掃描儲存庫中的 Ink 檔案…

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Migrated to the new SVG format.
ast.target: 已遷移至新的 SVG 格式。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: This is a legacy Ink file and won't support all the newest features. You can migrate it to the new SVG format now.
ast.target: 這是舊版 Ink 檔案，無法支援所有最新功能。你可以立即將它遷移至新的 SVG 格式。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Migrate legacy ink embeds to ink-canvas
ast.target: 將舊版 Ink 嵌入區塊遷移至 ink-canvas

ast.name: text
ast.target: 正在掃描儲存庫中的舊版嵌入區塊…

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Scanning for older tldraw SVG files…
ast.target: 正在掃描舊版 tldraw SVG 檔案…

ast.name: text
ast.source: No legacy Ink files were found in your vault. Nothing to migrate.
ast.target: 儲存庫中找不到舊版 Ink 檔案，無須遷移。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Migrate legacy ink files to new format
ast.target: 將舊版 Ink 檔案遷移至新格式

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 正在轉換舊版 SVG 檔案…

ast.name: text
ast.source: If satisfied, delete test conversions folder.
ast.target: 確認結果符合預期後，刪除測試轉換資料夾。

ast.name: text
ast.target: 再次執行遷移，並選擇永久遷移。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Migrate tldraw SVG files to ink-canvas
ast.target: 將 tldraw SVG 檔案遷移至 ink-canvas

ast.name: text
ast.source: Scanning vault for tldraw SVG files…
ast.target: 正在掃描儲存庫中的 tldraw SVG 檔案…

ast.name: text
ast.source: No v2 tldraw SVG files referenced by embeds were found. Nothing to migrate.
ast.target: 找不到嵌入區塊所參照的 v2 tldraw SVG 檔案，無須遷移。

ast.name: textContent
ast.target: 找不到 Ink 繪圖檔案。

ast.name: alert
ast.source:
Oops! We could not save changes to your browser's storage. We now need to reload the page and try again.

Keep seeing this message?
\u2022 If you're using tldraw in a private or "incognito" window, try loading tldraw in a regular window or in a different browser.
\u2022 If your hard disk is full, try clearing up some space and then reload the page.
ast.target:
糟糕！無法將變更儲存至瀏覽器的儲存空間。現在需要重新載入頁面後再試一次。

持續看到此訊息？
• 如果你在私密或「無痕」視窗中使用 tldraw，請改用一般視窗或其他瀏覽器。
• 如果硬碟空間已滿，請清出一些空間後重新載入頁面。

ast.name: alert
ast.source:
Oops! We could not access your browser's storage\u2014and the app won't work correctly without that. We now need to reload the page and try again.

Keep seeing this message?
\u2022 If you're using tldraw in a private or "incognito" window, try loading tldraw in a regular window or in a different browser.
ast.target:
糟糕！無法存取瀏覽器的儲存空間，應用程式將無法正常運作。現在需要重新載入頁面後再試一次。

持續看到此訊息？
• 如果你在私密或「無痕」視窗中使用 tldraw，請改用一般視窗或其他瀏覽器。

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Where should Ink files be saved when created in a note?
ast.target: 在筆記中建立 Ink 檔案時，要儲存在哪裡？

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Show frame around drawing when not editing
ast.target: 未編輯時在繪圖周圍顯示外框

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Show ruled lines when not editing

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Here's a quick rundown to help you get started...
ast.target: 以下是幫助你開始使用的快速介紹...

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Ink files live in your vault and can sync with it to other devices.
ast.target: Ink 檔案會保存在你的儲存庫中，並可同步到其他裝置。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: You can also follow along with development and let me know which features are important to you at the links below.
ast.target: 你也可以透過下方連結追蹤開發進度，並告訴我哪些功能對你很重要。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Hand write or draw directly between paragraphs in your notes.
ast.target: 直接在筆記段落之間手寫或繪圖。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: You may have noticed that your handwriting lines have started disapearing...
ast.target: 你可能已經注意到手寫線條開始消失...

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Hiding old strokes helps keep pen latency down and the writing experience smooth.
ast.target: 隱藏舊筆畫有助於降低觸控筆延遲，讓書寫體驗更順暢。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Never fear though, all your strokes still exist and will become visible again later.
ast.target: 別擔心，所有筆畫仍然存在，稍後會再次顯示。

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: There was an error finding a non-conflicting filename.
ast.target: 尋找不衝突的檔案名稱時發生錯誤。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Hand write or draw directly between paragraphs in your notes using a digital pen, stylus, or Apple pencil. Useful for handwriting, sketches, scribbles, or even math equations and scientific notation. Runs on the tldraw framework and drawing provides an infinite canvas.
ast.target: 使用數位筆、觸控筆或 Apple Pencil，直接在筆記段落之間手寫或繪圖。適合手寫、草圖、塗鴉，甚至數學方程式與科學符號。基於 tldraw 框架運作，繪圖提供無限畫布。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Hey, attend to this thing over here. It might be important!
ast.target: 嘿，請注意這裡。這可能很重要！

ast.name: message
ast.source: Revert to default settings for Ink plugin?
ast.target: 要將 Ink 外掛還原為預設設定嗎？

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If you notice any bugs, please report them through the link in the settings.
ast.target: 如果發現任何錯誤，請透過設定中的連結回報。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If disabled, you will not be able to add new writing embeds and those already embedded will appear as raw code. Existing writing files will be hidden in Obsidian but still exist on disk. Changing this setting will require a restart of Obsidian to take effect.
ast.target: 若停用，你將無法新增手寫嵌入區塊，已嵌入的區塊會以原始碼顯示。既有手寫檔案會在 Obsidian 中隱藏，但仍保留在磁碟上。變更此設定後需要重新啟動 Obsidian 才會生效。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If disabled, you will not be able to add new drawing embeds and those already embedded will appear as raw code. Existing drawing files will be hidden in Obsidian but still exist on disk. Changing this setting will require a restart of Obsidian to take effect.
ast.target: 若停用，你將無法新增繪圖嵌入區塊，已嵌入的區塊會以原始碼顯示。既有繪圖檔案會在 Obsidian 中隱藏，但仍保留在磁碟上。變更此設定後需要重新啟動 Obsidian 才會生效。

ast.name: error
ast.source: Could not finish Almost Useful login
ast.target: 無法完成 Almost Useful 登入

ast.name: error
ast.source: Could not start Almost Useful sign-in. Try again.
ast.target: 無法啟動 Almost Useful 登入，請再試一次。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: account for processing and is currently invite only.
ast.target: 帳號才能處理，目前僅接受邀請加入。

ast.name: HANDWRITING_TRANSCRIPTION_TOO_LONG_NOTICE
ast.source: This file can't be transcribed currently because it is too long. This will be fixed in a future update to Ink.
ast.target: 此檔案過長，目前無法轉錄。未來的 Ink 更新將修正此限制。

ast.name: message
ast.source: Almost Useful account is not signed in
ast.target: 尚未登入 Almost Useful 帳號

ast.name: message
ast.target: 手寫轉文字的回應無效

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Transcription requires an Almost Useful account. Link your account in Ink's settings.
ast.target: 轉錄需要 Almost Useful 帳號。請在 Ink 設定中連結你的帳號。

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Could not read ink file for transcription
ast.target: 無法讀取筆跡檔案以進行轉錄

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Transcription already in progress for this file

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Transcription will start when the current job finishes
ast.target: 目前的工作完成後，將開始轉錄

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Create and link an Almost Useful account to utilise handwriting transcription. Almost Useful is an accounts portal created by Dale de Silva, the developer of Ink.
ast.target: 建立並連結 Almost Useful 帳號以使用手寫轉文字功能。Almost Useful 是由 Ink 開發者 Dale de Silva 建立的帳號平台。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Almost Useful is currently in early access and is invite-only. If you have an account, sign in, or apply for an invite
ast.target: Almost Useful 目前處於搶先體驗階段，僅接受邀請加入。已有帳號可直接登入，或申請邀請：

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When Ink transcribes handwriting, your Ink SVG is sent over
ast.target: Ink 將手寫內容轉成文字時，你的 Ink SVG 會透過

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: model to read it. The transcript is returned to your app via the same route and stored in the SVG file as metadata and in all Markdown notes it is embedded in.
ast.target: 模型辨識。轉錄文字會循相同路徑回傳至應用程式，儲存為 SVG 檔案的中繼資料，並寫入所有嵌入該檔案的 Markdown 筆記。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Almost Useful does not store the SVG or transcript
ast.target: Almost Useful 在處理完成後不會於其伺服器上保留 SVG 或轉錄文字

ast.name: text
ast.source: Enter this code on the Almost Useful website to authorise Ink.
ast.target: 在 Almost Useful 網站輸入此驗證碼，以授權 Ink。

ast.name: text
ast.source:
Waiting for your authorisation on the website.
This screen will update automatically a few seconds after that's given.
ast.target:
正在等待你於網站上授權。
授權完成後，此畫面會在幾秒內自動更新。

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: Could not copy the code. Type it on the website instead.
ast.target: 無法複製驗證碼。請改為在網站上手動輸入。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Right click or tap and hold on a locked embed to copy or delete it.
ast.target: 在已鎖定的嵌入區塊上按右鍵或長按，即可複製或刪除。

ast.name: addLinkRow
ast.source: Version history, release notes, and download links for each Ink release.
ast.target: 各個 Ink 版本的歷史紀錄、版本說明與下載連結。

ast.name: addLinkRow
ast.source: Main repository with source code, roadmap, and project information.
ast.target: 包含原始碼、開發規劃與專案資訊的主要儲存庫。

ast.name: addLinkRow
ast.source: Submit feature requests, report bugs, or join the discussion.
ast.target: 提出功能需求、回報錯誤，或參與討論。

ast.name: textContent
ast.source: Transcription requires an Almost Useful account. Link your account above.
ast.target: 轉錄需要 Almost Useful 帳號。請在上方連結你的帳號。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: 0% always transcribes on close or sync; 95% only when ink is almost entirely different. Manual triggered  transcriptions ignore this.
ast.target: 設為 0% 時，每次關閉或同步都會轉錄；設為 95% 時，只有筆跡幾乎完全不同才會轉錄。手動觸發轉錄不受此設定限制。

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Re-transcribe when ink file changes significantly
ast.target: 筆跡檔案有明顯變更時重新轉錄

ast.name: push
ast.source: Duplicate failed: could not create copy
